what: hir-ty diagnostics/expr.rs ExprValidator::validate_block (line ~176) returns early when `!self.validate_lints`, so check_unused_must_use never runs under blaze: blaze-diagnostics check.rs:87 runs the plan with style_lints=false (the flag is for rust-analyzer's own style lints, RemoveTrailingReturn / RemoveUnnecessaryElse / ReplaceFilterMapNextWithFindMap, which blaze drops in lower/mod.rs:343-346). unused_must_use is rustc's lint (warn by default), so `#[must_use]` types and functions are never reported: no `unused ... that must be used` in any blaze-diagnostics output of round 15. Fix: in validate_block, call check_unused_must_use for each `Statement::Expr { has_semi: true }` whatever validate_lints is; keep the gate on the three style lints only.
